Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/5] Positive Affect was measured by an existing scale originally used by Mroczek and Kolarz (1998). The scale combines six items: "During the past 30 days, how much of the time did you feel (1) cheerful, (2) in good spirits, (3) extremely happy, (4) calm and peaceful, (5) satisfied and (6) full of life?"
